mapper.sql: t.id, t.user_id, t.record_id, t.blacklist_id, t.reason, t.submit_time, t.accept_org, t.within_window, t.status, t.ruling, t.ruler_id, t.ruling_time, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, DATE_ADD(t.submit_time, INTERVAL 9 DAY) AS deadline
FROM volunteer_appeal t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_appeal (user_id, record_id, blacklist_id, reason, submit_time, accept_org, within_window, status, ruling, ruler_id, ruling_time, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordId}, #{blacklistId}, #{reason}, #{submitTime}, #{acceptOrg}, #{withinWindow}, #{status}, #{ruling}, #{rulerId}, #{rulingTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_appeal SET status = #{toStatus}, ruling = #{ruling}, ruler_id = #{rulerId}, ruling_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE volunteer_appeal SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_appeal t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = #{status}
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM volunteer_appeal t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
